result:
All four packages are written, but I could not run `npm test` in any of them: Bash was denied in this session's don't-ask mode. Every test below was checked by hand against the code, not executed. Please run `npm test` in each folder.

## settingskit
- **`src/layer.mjs`** (new): exports `layer(base, over)`.
  - Plain objects under the same key are layered recursively; anything else in `over` replaces the base value.
  - Keys only one side has are kept, and arrays are replaced whole.
  - Both arguments must be plain objects (`Object.prototype` or null prototype), otherwise `TypeError`.
  - The result is a deep copy that shares no object or array with either argument, including inside arrays. `Date` values are cloned.
  - `__proto__`, `constructor` and `prototype` keys are dropped at any depth and inside arrays. Every plain object in the result is an ordinary object.
  - Beyond the brief: a cycle, a function, a `Map` or a class instance inside a layer throws `TypeError`, because those cannot be copied without sharing.
- **`tests/layer.test.mjs`** (new): one test per checklist item.
  - Item 2: tests "layer lays over on top of base", "plain objects under the same key", "an array, a number…" and "an array is replaced whole".
  - Item 3: "both arguments must be plain objects".
  - Item 4: "neither argument is changed" (deep-frozen inputs) and "the result shares no object or array" (identity walk, then mutating the result).
  - Item 5: "keys named __proto__, constructor or prototype…" using `JSON.parse`, plus prototype checks.
- **`CHANGELOG.md`**: one line under `## Unreleased`.
- Nothing else changed, so `README.md` and `package.json` are untouched (checklist item 8).

## textwrap
The README gave no spec for wrapping, so I chose the behaviour and documented it.
- **`src/wrap.mjs`** (new): `wrapText(text, width)`.
  - Breaks at spaces as late as the width allows, and keeps existing line breaks.
  - Collapses whitespace runs and trims lines.
  - Breaks words longer than `width` into pieces of `width` characters, so no line exceeds the width.
  - Counts length in code points.
  - A non-string `text` or non-number `width` throws `TypeError`; a `width` that is not a positive integer throws `RangeError`.
- **`tests/wrap.test.mjs`** (new) and **`README.md`** (a "Word wrapping" section).

## csvline
- **`src/csv.mjs`**: rewrote `parseCsvLine` as a linear-time scanner that uses `indexOf` and builds each field once.
  - Implements every contract line: `""` escapes, the closing-quote rule, an unterminated quote, a `"` outside quotes, one trailing terminator removed, and any other unquoted `\r` or `\n` rejected.
  - Only fields, `CsvError` or `TypeError` can come out.
- **`tests/csv.test.mjs`**: original tests kept and extended with:
  - each contract line;
  - 100 KB adversarial records, each required to finish in under 1 s;
  - an exhaustive check of every string up to length 6 over `" , a space \n \r`.

## semver-mini
- **`src/semver.mjs`**: implemented `compare`.
  - A strict semver.org grammar regex throws `RangeError` for invalid versions, and non-strings throw `TypeError` first.
  - Build metadata is ignored, a pre-release ranks below its release, numeric identifiers compare numerically (as digit strings, so any size works) and rank below alphanumeric ones, and a longer identifier list ranks higher.
  - Returns exactly -1, 0 or 1.
- `tests/semver.test.mjs` is unchanged.
